# Initial guesses of trend

* Fertility drop started with urbanization; maybe around 2000-2010

* Probably has higher fertility than Pakistan, definitely higher than Nepal; probably lower than India

* Life expectancy probably rose first before fertility fell

# Comparison countries
a.  India   \
b.  Pakistan    \
c.  Nepal  

# Main study

## **The intial guesses were correct and also analysis of demography of Bangladesh**

* *how did Bangladesh’s fertility and life expectancy change from 1950 on, and how does it compare with its neighbors?*


Load data
```{r}
df_f <- read.csv("children-per-woman-un.csv")
df_e <- read.csv("life-expectancy-hmd-unwpp.csv")
```

inspect
```{r}
str(df_f)
str(df_e)

df_e |> 
  anyNA()
df_f |>
  anyNA()
```
checking...
```{r}
unique(df_e[,1:2])
"---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------"
unique(df_f[,1:2])
```


required codes
```{r}
t_df_e <- df_e |> 
  filter(Code == "BGD" | Code == "NPL" | Code == "IND" | Code == "PAK")
t_df_f <- df_f |> 
  filter(Code == "BGD" | Code == "NPL" | Code == "IND" | Code == "PAK")
```

merge
```{r}
df <- merge(t_df_f,t_df_e)
str(df)
```
Rename columns 
```{r}
df <- df |>
  rename(country = Entity,
         code = Code,
         year = Year,
         fert_rate = Fertility.rate,
         life_exp = Life.expectancy.at.birth..totals..period
         )
```
create country specific dataframes
```{r}
df_bd <- df |> 
  filter(code == "BGD")
df_ind <- df |> 
  filter(code == "IND")
df_pak <- df |> 
  filter(code == "PAK")
df_npl <- df |> 
  filter(code == "NPL")
```

plots
```{r}
df |> 
ggplot(aes(x = year, y = fert_rate, color = country)) + geom_line() + expand_limits(y =0) +
  labs(title = "Fertility rate VS. Time")
```


```{r}
df |> 
ggplot(aes(x = year, y = life_exp, color = country)) + geom_line() + expand_limits(y =0) +
  labs(title = "Life Expectancy VS. Time")
```




```{r}
str(df)
```
